rules.title: Metadata file must be .csv
rules.description: The metadata file must be a .csv (comma-separated values) file, not .xls, .xlsx or another type.

rules.title: CSV file larger than 1 MB
rules.description: The CSV file must be 1 MB or smaller. More than 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB) exceeds 1 MB under every common definition and is an error.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'The overall document must be 1MB or smaller.' Size is measured in bytes on disk, including any BOM.

rules.title: CSV file larger than 1,000,000 bytes
rules.description: The file is larger than 1,000,000 bytes (1 MB decimal) but not larger than 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB). The source does not say which definition of MB applies.

rules.title: More than 5,000 data rows
rules.description: A CSV file may contain at most 5,000 data rows.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Limit your CSV to a maximum of 5,000 rows.' StockMetaLint counts data rows (header and blank records excluded); the source does not say whether the header counts.

rules.title: CSV is not valid UTF-8
rules.description: The CSV must be saved as UTF-8 ('CSV UTF-8' in Excel). Invalid byte sequences and UTF-16 files are rejected.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'If you're located outside the US and using Excel to create a CSV file, you need save your document as CSV UTF-8.' StockMetaLint requires valid UTF-8 for every file because other encodings cannot be decoded deterministically.

rules.title: Template header row missing
rules.description: The first record does not contain any template column (Filename, Title, Keywords, Category, Releases). Row checks are skipped.
rules.notes: Header spelling Filename,Title,Keywords,Category,Releases is a seed value; the official template file could not be downloaded in this build.

rules.title: Required column missing
rules.description: A required column (Filename, Title or Keywords) is missing from the header.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Other columns are optional, but we highly recommend that you add categories.'

rules.title: Header spelling differs from the template
rules.description: A header cell differs from the template spelling by case, spacing, plural form or a small typo. Headers must match the official template exactly.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Use the exact headers from the official template without changes.'

rules.title: Column not in the template
rules.description: The header contains a column that is not part of the official template.

rules.title: Duplicate header column
rules.description: A template column appears more than once in the header; only the first occurrence is checked.

rules.title: Optional template column absent
rules.description: An optional template column (Category or Releases) is absent. Keeping the column with empty cells matches the template exactly.

rules.title: Columns not in template order
rules.description: Template columns are present but not in template order (Filename, Title, Keywords, Category, Releases). Whether the uploader enforces column order is not documented.

rules.title: Filename is empty
rules.description: The Filename cell is empty.

rules.title: Filename longer than 30 characters
rules.description: Filename, including the extension, must be 30 characters or fewer.
rules.notes: A web-search summary noted the 30-character filename limit appears only on some localized versions of the page; re-verify against the live page.

rules.title: Filename has no extension
rules.description: Filename must be the exact asset file name including its extension (for example Myphoto1.jpg).
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Exact filename including extension (e.g., Myphoto1.jpg, Myvideo1.mov).'

rules.title: Filename is a path, not a file name
rules.description: Filename must be a bare file name: no directory separators, '..' traversal, absolute paths or drive letters such as C:.
rules.notes: Derived from 'Exact filename including extension'; also blocks path traversal.

rules.title: Title is empty
rules.description: The Title cell is empty.

rules.title: Title longer than 70 characters
rules.description: Title must be 70 characters or fewer, counted as Unicode code points. Text is never truncated automatically.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Title, 70 characters maximum, plain text description without commas or special characters.'

rules.title: Title contains a comma
rules.description: The source describes the title as a plain-text description without commas.
rules.notes: 'Special characters' is not defined by the source, so only commas are checked. Severity is warning because rejection behavior is not documented.

rules.title: Keywords is empty
rules.description: The Keywords cell has no keywords.

rules.title: More than 50 keywords
rules.description: At most 50 comma-separated keywords per row in the CSV. Keyword order is preserved; nothing is removed automatically.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Include a maximum of 50 keywords, and don't include technical data.' Guidance pages mention 49; see ADOBE-GUIDANCE-KEYWORDS-49 and docs/rule-discrepancies.md.

rules.title: Category is not a number
rules.description: Category must be a category number (ASCII digits only).
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Enter the number of the category that best describes the content.'

rules.title: Category number not in the seed list
rules.description: The Category number is not in the seed category list (1-21).
rules.notes: The complete numbered list could not be verified, so this is a warning, not an error.

rules.title: Rows without Category
rules.description: Category is optional, but the source highly recommends adding categories.
rules.notes: Reported once per file with the number of affected rows.

rules.title: Release name longer than 30 characters
rules.description: Each release name in the Releases cell must be 30 characters or fewer.
rules.notes: Snippet: 'Releases need to be JPEGs with filenames that are 30 characters or fewer.' StockMetaLint splits the cell on commas; the multi-release separator is not confirmed.

rules.title: More than 49 keywords (guidance advisory)
rules.description: Advisory, editorial profile only: Adobe guidance pages say keywords can be added 'up to 49 per content submission', while the CSV requirements page allows 50. Never applied by default.
rules.notes: The project brief attributes the 49 figure to the editorial submission guide; search snippets show it on general guidance pages too. Scoped separately from ADOBE-CSV-KEYWORDS-MAX.

rules.title: Photo resolution outside 4-100 MP
rules.description: Inspect mode, JPEG only: image resolution is below 4 or above 100 megapixels.

rules.title: Photo file larger than 45 MB
rules.description: Inspect mode, JPEG only: file is larger than 45,000,000 bytes.
rules.notes: MB vs MiB is not documented; the decimal value is the conservative choice.

rules.title: Video codec is not H.264
rules.description: Inspect mode with ffprobe: the first video stream is not H.264.

rules.title: Video duration outside 5-60 seconds
rules.description: Inspect mode with ffprobe: container duration is below 5 or above 60 seconds.
